stories.title: U.S. prosecution opposes release of alleged co-conspirator in B.C. mass shooting
stories.summary: The accused co-conspirator in the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., prioritized her loyalty to the killer over the lives of innocent children and she shouldn’t be released before trial, U.S federal prosecutors say.

stories.title: Poilievre says nurse may lose job after photo with him at Wainwright
stories.summary: OTTAWA — Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre said a nurse working on contract at the Canadian Forces Base Wainwright has been told she might lose her job after she was photographed speaking with him in the aftermath of the Wainwright tragedy.

stories.title: Bad weather postpones Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade for first time ever
stories.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade will also be a first: Organizers made an unprecedented decision to postpone the event to Saturday because of bad weather .

stories.title: Army calls detonation of bomb chemicals in Iowa a success after earlier fears of a toxic plume
High winds and rain continue; evacuation orders in several Island communities
stories.summary: Evacuation alerts have been issued in the Regional District of Nanaimo, Parksville and Gwa’sala-‘Nakwaxda’xw Nation on Vancouver Island as heavy rain and high winds continue to pummel coastal B.C.

stories.title: Evacuation alerts issued on Vancouver Island as coastal flooding threat rises
stories.summary: VANCOUVER — Marc Doll had been planning to use the planks of wood he watched float past his window on Tuesday to build a deck, but they've been put to a more urgent purpose as relentless rain swamped his property on British Columbia's Quadra Island.

stories.title: Plane crash off the coast of Mississippi kills extended family of 6 on fishing trip
stories.summary: Authorities are investigating why a small plane carrying six members of a Florida family crashed off the Mississippi coast on Tuesday. They were returning home from a fishing trip, relatives say.

stories.title: Author Steven Galloway not fired from UBC for sex assault allegations, court hears
stories.summary: VANCOUVER — The University of British Columbia didn't terminate author Steven Galloway as a professor due to sexual assault allegations, and the woman who accused him shouldn't be held liable for the university's actions, her lawyer told the B.C.

stories.title: Immigrants in Canada more likely to be overqualified for their jobs: report
stories.summary: OTTAWA — A new report says too many newcomers to Canada are getting stuck in jobs they are overqualified to do, undermining the federal government's quest to recruit highly educated, highly specialized workers from abroad.

stories.title: Senate committee makes amendments to Liberal government's 'lawful access' bill
stories.summary: OTTAWA — A Senate committee has made several amendments to the Liberal government's "lawful access" bill with the aim of reinforcing privacy safeguards and clarifying provisions.

stories.title: Health Canada warns of rare vision loss risk with Ozempic and other semaglutide drugs
stories.summary: TORONTO — Health Canada has issued a warning about a "very rare" risk of vision loss with Ozempic, Wegovy and other semaglutide drugs.
